title: Correlated EXISTS / NOT EXISTS support for LDBC Query 14 frontier

steps.step: Confirm BENCHPROD-102 blocker and current subquery materialization behavior
Defer EXISTS / NOT EXISTS predicates that require an outer row
Evaluate deferred EXISTS / NOT EXISTS predicates after scan/join row construction
Add correlated NOT EXISTS regression coverage for CTE and LDBC join-alias shapes
Run targeted SQL tests, release build, pg integration, and non-isolation LDBC smoke

result.ldbc_frontier: LDBC Query 14 executes past Column k_person2id not found and now times out after one operation at 180 seconds

remaining_blockers: LDBC Query 14 recursive path expansion can run for longer than the smoke timeout with current naive per-row EXISTS execution
LDBC Query 14 array concatenation and multidimensional array access are still incomplete production risks
LDBC Query 14 generate_subscripts and weighted path aggregation remain unproven
next_task: BENCHPROD-104: isolate LDBC Query 14 timeout with targeted SQL/profiling, then decide between recursion bound/pruning and array SQL support
